measurement_limits: Three samples per comparison; stochastic model behavior and service latency. No significance claim.
Baseline/v1 were interleaved; v2-v4 followed later. Runtime comparison is observational.
Cumulative input tokens differ from maximum single-request context. Model request count is estimated from usage updates.
Discovery output bytes also include other output in the same program cell.
context_loss uses two fresh Codex conversations, not actual automatic compaction.
batch_recovery seeds a dispatch interruption before real child spawn, not an injected spawn failure.
Windows-only 11 tests were not run. Host Homebrew installation and active MCP process were not changed.
